BST/GMT CHANGEOVER — EXACT CUTOVER
British Summer Time ended at 02:00 BST on Sunday 25 October 2026, which is 01:00 UTC. 25 October is the last Sunday of October 2026 (Sundays: 4, 11, 18, 25).
Consequence for JSON-LD "Z" timestamps:
 - Any item stamped BEFORE 2026-10-25T01:00:00Z: local British time = UTC + 1 hour (BST).
 - Any item stamped AT OR AFTER 2026-10-25T01:00:00Z: local British time = UTC + 0 (GMT).
Last night was 25 hours long. Any warning, deadline or duration spanning 02:00 local gains an hour of elapsed time.

Today is Sunday 25 October 2026. The Budget is Wednesday 28 October 2026. 28 minus 25 = 3. Intervening days: Monday 26, Tuesday 27, Budget on Wednesday 28. The Budget is THREE DAYS AWAY. "Four days out" is wrong.
